title: 哭
teacherNotes: Accepted Production handoff. Latest origin/main is complete through L287 痛, so build lesson-local complete package only and block until L288-L294 are in main. Use origin/main L001-L287 plus provisional learned chars [受,忍,耐,敢,當,然,怕] and current target 哭 for allowed-character audit. Pain, injury, fear, and crying scenes must remain gentle, child-safe, non-bloody, non-severe, and non-frightening. S05 must not look like fighting, bullying, or violent attack.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: origin/main L001-L287 + provisional learned chars [受,忍,耐,敢,當,然,怕] + current target 哭
usageNotes: Images may depict fear of pain, small injury, discomfort, and near-crying, but must remain gentle and child-safe.
Do not depict blood, severe injury, emergency, medical horror, frightening scenes, fighting, bullying, or violent attack.
Do not use unapproved display characters outside the allowed boundary.
Images must not contain text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, or watermarks.
imageRules: All sentence images must be square image / 1:1 composition.
Use L058 only as style reference, not person identity.
Use protagonist family continuity from L154/L162/L163.
Every human prompt must explicitly name the role identity.
No visible text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, brands, logos, or readable marks.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate charAudio for 哭 as public/assets/lessons/L295/audio/char-u54ed.m4a from the single character.
Generate G02 prefix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
If G02 suffix is empty, omit suffix audio from draft unless tooling requires a placeholder; do not cut from full sentence audio.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩手上或腳上有一點小傷，表情很怕痛但努力忍著不哭，主角媽媽在旁邊關心。畫面要清楚呈現怕痛、忍著不哭；不可血腥，不可有文字、數字、標籤。
主角小女孩有一點小傷，覺得痛而哭了，主角媽媽在旁邊安撫。畫面要清楚呈現受傷很痛、當然會哭；不可血腥，不可有文字、數字、標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 我不怕黑，我敢晚上出門。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 我不怕黑我敢晚上出門
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩在晚上站在家門口，外面天色暗但不恐怖，她表情有信心，主角媽媽或主角爸爸在旁邊陪伴。畫面要清楚呈現不怕黑、敢晚上出門；不可畫成恐怖場景，不可有文字、數字、標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 耐心等紅燈，然後當心過馬路。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 耐心等紅燈然後當心過馬路
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩和主角媽媽站在路口等紅燈，等好之後準備當心過馬路。畫面要清楚呈現耐心等紅燈、然後當心過馬路；不可有交通號誌文字、數字、車牌或標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 不要打到我，不然我會哭。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 不要打到我不然我會哭
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩和另一個孩子在玩球或玩具，另一個孩子的球或玩具揮得太靠近，主角小女孩退一步，表情委屈快哭。畫面要清楚呈現「不要打到我，不然我會哭」的提醒；不可畫成打架、霸凌或暴力攻擊，不可有文字、數字、標籤。

stage4Plan.reason: 「我會哭」是本課核心情緒用法，目標字清楚。

stage4Plan.correctText: 我不怕黑，我敢晚上出門。

我不怕黑，我敢晚上回家。
